title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2611.29519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent frameworks typically orchestrate language models through prompt-and-response interfaces. We propose a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime. By connecting state collection, policy fitting, and execution, the design enables policies to allocate computation within and across models based on intermediate states. We demonstrate the approach with a prototype that learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then applies them during inference to select among continue, exit, and stitch. For dispatcher supervision, we select the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction, using continue when neither early action matches. We train these components on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items authored using source texts sampled from WildChat

translated_title: 智能体框架中语言模型执行的层级别控制
translated_abstract: 智能体框架通常通过提示-响应接口来编排语言模型。我们提出了一种测试框架设计，将中间模型状态和层级别的执行控制暴露给智能体运行时。通过连接状态收集、策略拟合与执行，该设计使策略能够基于中间状态在单个模型内部以及跨模型之间分配计算。我们通过一个原型演示了该方法：该原型从配对的模型状态中学习拼接桥和状态条件执行策略，然后在推理过程中应用它们，在继续、退出和拼接之间进行选择。对于调度器监督，我们选择计算量最小且其全词表下一词预测与源模型全深度预测相匹配的动作；当没有任何早期动作匹配时则使用继续动作。我们在一个包含5,000个类型化决策项的冻结代理语料库上训练这些组件，这些决策项使用从WildChat采样的源文本编写而成。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将语言模型的中间状态和层级别执行控制暴露给智能体运行时的框架设计，通过从配对模型状态中学习拼接桥与状态条件执行策略，在推理时动态选择继续、退出或跨模型拼接动作，从而基于中间状态智能分配模型内与跨模型的计算资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to agent runtimes, learning stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies that dynamically select among continue, exit, and stitch actions during inference to allocate computation within and across models.
